got_right: An object at rest stays at rest; a moving object keeps moving at constant speed in a straight line.
missed: This continues unless an unbalanced (external) force acts on it.
result.hint: If a hockey puck is sliding on perfectly smooth ice with no friction or air resistance, what will happen to its speed and direction over time?
result.feedback: You correctly identified that objects resist changes in motion and named this property as inertia. To fully understand the law, you should also mention that a moving object continues at a constant speed in a straight line unless acted upon by an unbalanced force.

got_right: Higher demand (with the same supply) usually raises the price.
